_comment: Handgepflegt (Issue #99): Englischer 'Was ist neu'-Text für GENAU die Version im Feld 'version'. Der CHANGELOG ist nur deutsch und wird nicht maschinell übersetzt (Owner-Entscheidung) - 'title' und 'en' werden beim Release von Hand geschrieben, sinngemäß zum deutschen CHANGELOG-Abschnitt derselben Version. Der Generator (scripts/generate-whatsnew.mjs) übernimmt 'en' NUR, wenn 'version' hier exakt zur aktuellen APP_VERSION passt - sonst bleibt EN absichtlich leer, damit eine vergessene Übersetzung nicht lautlos durchrutscht (siehe web/scripts/check-whatsnew.mjs).
en:
Backup before updating recommended. On first start PokéCollect adds a new table for pending scans; existing data stays as it is. Update the image matcher too — the stamp check, reverse holo detection and edge suggestions need its new version. Then learn the stamp template again (Admin → Play! stamps → Learn template) and upload a model for reverse holo detection (Admin → Reverse holo detection).

• New: pending scans — the scan review is saved on the server; leave the page and continue later or on another device. "Pending scans" in the menu, the bottom bar and next to Scan, each with a count; the list shows the whole photo with the cards outlined (yellow open, green saved), a tap opens it large. The same card is never saved twice. Pending scans expire after 30 days and are not in backups.
• New: "Confirm later · next photo" — scan a pile of cards and confirm them later.
• New: no card found is no longer an error — the photo stays as a pending scan and the cards can be outlined by hand.
• New: the whole photo in the scan review, every found card outlined and numbered like the list (tap a number to jump to it), so a missed card stands out; it can be hidden. Each card shows the scanned photo and the catalog image side by side.
• New: Play! stamp in the scan — the template is learned from the stamps marked in the collection; the scan checks every card, ticks Prize Pack when sure ("stamp 93%") and shows "stamp?" when likely. The stamp editor suggests where the stamp is.
• New: reverse holo in the scan — with an uploaded model the review asks "Reverse holo? — tap to set" for normal cards that exist as reverse holo. Newer sets print the set code box inverted on reverse holos; on 860 of our own scans 9 in 10 questions were right and 98% of reverse holos were asked.
• New: 1st Edition and condition in the scan form; "1st Edition" is always there, also where the catalog knows no such print.
• New: corner editor — move edges and the whole frame; a turned view counts as upright. Edge suggestions also when adding a missed card and in "Adjust corners".
• New: find picture — crop with a suggestion, aligned to the artwork of same-name prints.
• New: admins can fix crops and stamps of every user's cards (other users' cards stay private otherwise).
• New: image matcher tools — dataset_report.py (is the scan dataset big enough to train on?), stamp_eval.py (measure the stamp thresholds), foil_eval.py (build the reverse holo model; lists cards whose foiling looks wrong).
• Changed: the matcher's shortlist corrects for the gap between photos and catalog images — right first match on scan photos 72% → 92% (EMBED_DOMAIN=0 turns it off).
• Changed: crop suggestions recognise "a Pokémon card" by its typical frame instead of sleeves and binder pockets (binder photos: corner error 3.2% → 1.5%).
• Fixed: basic energy is recognised by its name — decks flagged some as "not legal".
• Fixed: stats donuts — the legend sits below the ring instead of over it.
title: Pending scans, the whole photo in the review, Play! stamps and reverse holos in the scan
